visualCharacteristics: Light-section, image-forward story carousel. Each slide is a tile showing a story image with a category label overlaid and a linked headline beneath. Multiple tiles are visible at once in a horizontally scrollable/swipable row with prev/next controls.
contentPattern: Container block with one row per slide: image cell + text cell (title/headline link).
usage: Use to present a swipable row of story teaser tiles below a section heading.
